unknowns.unknown_en: Build orientation, supports, meaning of layer thickness, power, exposure/curing, cleaning liquids, washout, actual tray release and waste SOP are unreported; do not restate 75 micron as confirmed layer height
Loading mass, replenishment interface, containers and actual handling safety are unknown; do not provide real resin-handling recipes
Do not automatically inherit shaft diameter, blade thickness, outer wall or manufacturing tolerances beyond Fig1; the spectrum-sample section does not separately repeat their numerical D
Complete tube length, hole depth, sealing, clamping force, face localization and inner diameter are unknown; previous asset coordinates are authored only
SI's 7 cm belongs to numerical validation; physical four-point absolute positions, face references and unused-hole handling are incompletely specified
Amplifier model, gain, wiring/impedance topology, power supply, DS345 setting sequence, sound level and source/tube coupling are unknown
Stable phase reference for sequential single-probe sampling, synchronization, sample rate, window, repeats, calibration and trigger details are unreported
Envelope, cycle count, transmitter/receiver positions, pulse load, arrival-time estimator and trigger definition are unknown
Holder clamping/sealing, cell-number-to-experimental-axis orientation, phase zero and assembly tolerance are unknown
Material/weight of the 3 m plates, lift/support system, actual upper-plate assembly/removal path and spacers are unspecified
The source gives no coupling/adapter geometry between 40 mm speakers and the 28 mm plate gap
Probe entry into the enclosed 28 mm gap, probe-shaft/cable routing and full-scan reachability are unknown; Fig10 is not a mechanical drawing
Exact axis assignment, origin/endpoints, grid and scan speed for the 2.3 x 1.0 m area are unspecified; existing stage transforms do not establish full coverage
The source gives diameter, material and source coordinates but not height, fixation, insertion path or measured positioning tolerance
Raw waveforms and exact processing scripts are unavailable; a pressure-amplitude map is not automatically calibrated acoustic energy-flux intensity
Existing .glb files and display transforms lack physical constraints, sensors and contact/grasp/collision/reachability validation
Real cleaners, resin treatment/disposal and component-lifetime specifications are absent
